title: Church Holiness
definition: Church Holiness is the calling of Christ's people to be set apart from sin and devoted to God in doctrine, worship, conduct, and witness.
summary: The Church must reflect the holy character of the Lord who redeemed her.
christFocus: Jesus Christ cleanses His Church and presents her holy before Himself.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church Holiness teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is the church must reflect the holy character of the lord who redeemed her.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Church Holiness calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let church holiness move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
